messages:
Maya P: Quick heads-up — planning a canary for orchid-service today at 15:00 PT (22:00 UTC). Will run gradual percent ramp, need a deploy owner, smoke owner, and rollback-ready ack.
Liam: I can own the deploy window. ETA to start infra changes is 15:00 PT. :wave:
Sanjay: happy to be smoke owner — I’ll run the lightweight checks and watch latency/4xx spikes for the first 30m.
Jon R: FYI code review 3542 merged, feature-flag gating is in place. Rolling via traffic-switch, not new instances.
Maya P: plan: 0.1% -> wait 10m -> 1% -> wait 15m -> 5% -> wait 20m -> 25% -> monitor 30m then full. If anything >3% increase p99 or >1.5x error rate vs baseline, roll back immediately.
Elaine: can we add a small geo holdout? prefer to keep APAC off for first two waves.
Liam: yup — cohort selection: US-West + US-East for 0.1/1/5. Hold APAC until 25% bump.
Sanjay: posting the smoke checklist:
```
- sample queries (chat, summarization, embed)
- sanity token usage
- latency p50/p95/p99 check
- error-rate and 5xx alarms
- KV cache hit sanity
```
Jon R: rollback commands (if needed):
```
# quick traffic revert
redwood traffic switch orchid-service --to=baseline --confirm
# infra fallback (for reserved lanes)
terraform apply -var='orchid_force_revert=true' -target=module.orchid_route
```
Maya P: @Jon R can you double-check the revert cmds before we go live? want them copy-pastable in ops doc.
Jon R: done — added with exact flags in the runbook. Small tweak: add --no-wait for immediate switch.
DeployBot: Deploy window booked by Liam for 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC. Canary percentage plan attached to deployment metadata.
OpsBot: Reminder: set PagerDuty to on-call rotation for infra and ml-sre for 22:00–00:00 UTC.
Elaine: all set from my side. I'll keep a rolling note in the incidents channel for any anomalies.
Liam: starting the preflight at 14:30 PT — healthchecks, canary artifact verification, and traffic policy dry-run.
Maya P: thanks everyone — ping here once you have the preflight green. If green, we kickoff at 15:00 PT and follow the percent plan above. :thumbsup:
